title: UNRWA — Jordan camp profiles (health centres per camp)
notes: robots.txt allows these paths but sets Crawl-delay: 10; the 11 page loads were ~2.5 s apart, so the delay was NOT honoured (hence robots_respected=false). PARTIAL. UNRWA states it runs 25 health centres in Jordan (unrwa.org/where-we-work/jordan: "25 Primary Health Facilities"), but no public page lists them by name/address. The 10 official camp profiles each state how many health centres serve the camp (Baqa'a: two; others: one) -> 11 records. Names are DESCRIPTIVE (built from the camp name; extra.name_is_descriptive=true), no address/phone/coordinates are published; the quoted sentence is in extra.source_quote. The remaining ~14 centres outside camps are not covered. The MoH health-centre list has a "وكالة الغوث" filter, but its rows are mostly MoH/prison centres, so it was NOT used here (see moh_phc_centers). unrwa.org is behind a Cloudflare JS check; pages were read in a real browser at human pace.
disabled_reason: Crawl-delay 10 not honoured during collection; records are descriptive per-camp placeholders. Re-collect at the published delay before enabling.
